_comment: enabled:false = kill switch (compose, publish nothing). mode:draft = Buffer drafts for review / live = schedule for real. research_per_day = target AI-trend posts per day, EACH cross-posted to every channel in `channels` (raise this digit to scale up; the quality gate still applies). linkedin_format = 'carousel' means EVERY LinkedIn post ships as a carousel PDF deck (not a single image), so with research_per_day=2 you get a GUARANTEED 2 LinkedIn carousels/day, one per research topic — see config/carousel.md; 'auto' restores the old conditional (carousel only for breakdowns). X always uses a single image (no native carousel). skip_days = weekday abbrevs (UTC) to NOT post on (mon,tue,wed,thu,fri,sat,sun). posting_windows_utc = ordered list of 'HH:MM-HH:MM' UTC windows the routine schedules dueAt into (Step 8); currently ['04:00-05:00','15:00-17:00'] = 9-10am & 8-10pm Pakistan time (PKT=UTC+5). The 00:30 UTC run fills the FIRST window (morning), the 12:30 UTC run the SECOND (evening); SAME windows for X and LinkedIn, each post a random independent minute inside. Edit these to retime posts — no routine-prompt change needed. The Ployo diary routine separately posts 1 diary/day to these same channels.
